lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Reward: Buffet Coupon ×2

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Thank you for bringing us a fun little challenge.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: As a thank you, Novel and I got you a present.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: We had a blast

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: analyzing this old phone.
Did you find anything?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Yes, as much as we're ever going to.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: First of all, the owner of the phone is Jade Hansen.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: A soldier who took part in the First Invasion.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: He went missing in action, and that was all we knew for the longest time.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: However, his son is still alive

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: and currently lives in the Ark, so I was able to contact him.
When were the messages actually sent?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: That's where it gets interesting.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: They were sent while Jade was on active duty.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: During that time, the Alva particles

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: rendered all communication between allies impossible.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I'm guessing he got separated from his squad,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: and began desperately sending out SOS messages with his phone.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It just so happens one of those messages was sent to your phone.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: That's my hypothesis, anyway.
But how is that possible?
How is the phone's battery still working?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I'm quite mystified myself.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: My speculation is that

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: the Alva particle concentration somehow decreased,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: causing the messages to finally come through at a later time.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: But theoretically speaking... that's virtually impossible.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It's a complete mystery.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Considering all the wear and tear from the elements,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: this phone shouldn't be even close to functional.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Yet, here we are.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Actually, by the time we received it, it has already stopped running.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Anyway, I'll look into it,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: but don't get your hopes up.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: For now, the prevailing speculation is that it was possessed by some entity.
Gives me the willies just thinking about it.
It's such a sad story.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Indeed.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: But don't think too much about it.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Just consider it an interesting experience.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: See you.
